skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions or mixed numbers with common denominators without requiring borrowing or simplification.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominators
skills.definition: Identifying a common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Handling Whole Numbers
skills.definition: Subtracting whole numbers from mixed numbers, or subtracting mixed numbers/fractions from whole numbers.

skills.name: Regrouping/Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from a whole number or regrouping an improper fraction to perform subtraction when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's.
